blueprints.description: Users, roles and permissions, settings and an audit log for an administrator: a user list and page, a roles list beside its permission matrix, a settings form and a read-only audit log.

screens.name: admin.users
screens.title: Users
screens.description: Everyone with an account: role, status and when they were last active; invite someone.

screens.name: admin.users.record
screens.title: User
screens.description: One user: profile, role assignments and sessions.

screens.name: admin.roles
screens.title: Roles and permissions
screens.description: The roles on the left and what the chosen role may do on the right.

screens.name: admin.settings
screens.title: Settings
screens.description: General, branding and notification settings of the organization.

screens.name: admin.audit
screens.title: Audit log
screens.description: Who did what to what and when, read only; filtered and exported.

templates.name: AdministrationUserList
templates.description: Users with name, email, role, status and last active, filtered by role, status and last active; an invite action.

templates.name: AdministrationUserPage
templates.description: One user: profile, role assignments and sessions.

templates.name: AdministrationRoles
templates.description: The roles on the left and the permission matrix of the chosen role on the right.

templates.name: AdministrationSettings
templates.description: General, branding and notification settings, each section with its own Save.

templates.name: AdministrationAuditLog
templates.description: Time, actor, action and target of every change, filtered by actor, action and date range; exportable.

templates.name: AdministrationInviteUser
templates.description: A short form that invites someone by email with a role, without leaving the page.

templates.name: AdministrationQuickCreateRole
templates.description: A short form that creates one role without leaving the page.
